hypothesis: Adding 15% verified interference-binding cognition data causes measurable cognitive acquisition beyond ordinary language training at matched compute.
loss_matched_analysis: compare at equal tokens AND at matched natural validation loss
primary_claim: Treatment pair-accuracy on frozen DEV-OOD interference binding at 200M tokens exceeds matched control, clustered by semantic instance.
promotion_stop_rules: two consecutive Tier-1 worst-family declines above 5 points while LM loss improves: pause
nonfinite loss or gradient: abort update and run
fresh candidate-free and natural-transfer gains absent: deny V5-A
seeds_replication: second seed replicates direction; fresh natural transfer paired LCB above zero
statistical_unit: semantic cluster (surfaces of one latent instance count once)
substrate_metric: natural validation loss regression at most 3%
